plan.summary: Changes the stack status label for members that need a rebase. The label `needs rebasing` becomes `needs to move`. The condition `needsRebase(member)` and the `up to date` label stay the same.
plan.riskRationale: One string literal changes in a label function. Any code or test that matches the old string will break, but the diff does not show such code.
plan.storyArc: One user-facing label changes wording. The only meaningful review question is whether anything depends on the old string.

topics.title: Stack status label says "needs to move"
topics.narrativeBrief: What text does statusLabel return for a member that needs a rebase? Show the one-line string change. Verify that no caller, test, or UI code compares against 'needs rebasing'.
